components.html: Giacca di lana45 €
components.css: .ds-tray{background:var(--nap),var(--tray);border:1px solid var(--brass-line);border-radius:var(--radius-lg);box-shadow:var(--lift);padding:10px}.ds-slot{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;padding:10px 14px 10px 8px;background:var(--nap),var(--well);border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:var(--radius);box-shadow:var(--recess);color:var(--text);text-decoration:none;transition:border-color var(--t)}.ds-slot:hover{border-color:var(--brass-line)}.ds-slot:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--brass-hi);outline-offset:2px}.ds-thumb{width:72px;height:72px;flex-shrink:0;border-radius:8px;background:var(--well-hi);box-shadow:0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.5);transition:transform 220ms var(--ease),box-shadow 220ms var(--ease)}.ds-slot:hover .ds-thumb,.ds-slot:focus-visible .ds-thumb{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 12px 18px -6px rgba(0,0,0,.85),0 0 0 1px var(--brass-line)}.ds-slot-text{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;flex:1;min-width:0}.ds-slot-text strong{font-weight:650}.ds-price{color:var(--brass-hi);font-weight:700}.ds-marks{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,54px);justify-items:center}.ds-dot{position:relative;width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--idle)}.ds-pub{background:var(--ok);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--ok-soft)}.ds-fill{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--ok);background:radial-gradient(circle,var(--ok) 0 2px,transparent 2.5px)}.ds-half{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--warn);background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--warn) 50%,transparent 50%)}.ds-err{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--err)}.ds-err::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:-2px;right:-2px;top:50%;height:1.5px;margin-top:-.75px;background:var(--err);transform:rotate(-45deg)}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-slot:hover .ds-thumb,.ds-slot:focus-visible .ds-thumb{transform:none}}

narrative.overview:
Every listing is an object seated in its own recess on a dark bottle-green velvet tray; the five marketplaces are brass tags along its rail. The ground has nap: a fine, directional noise texture drawn once as an SVG and laid over the html ground, the body, every tray and every well. Depth is physical: trays rise on soft downward shadows, wells and fields sink with a dark top edge.

One dark theme only (`color-scheme: dark`). Density is an operator's: long listing slots at one photo scale, state read at a glance in fixed cells, Italian copy throughout. The system refuses the category default of near-black SaaS panels, one neon accent and glowing card edges.
keyCharacteristics: Velvet ground, tray and well tones, all carrying the nap texture.
Brass is solid (metal fill) only on what can be pressed; everywhere else it is engraved: brass outline, brass text.
Ivory text in three tiers; the faintest still clears 4.5:1 on velvet.
Site state is a mark in a fixed cell, never a free-floating badge.
Engraved roman headings (Marcellus), one workhorse sans (Albert Sans) for every control and number.

rules.name: The Pressable Brass Rule
rules.body: Solid brass metal appears only on an element that can be pressed (primary button, checked-toggle tick). Anything informational uses engraved brass: a brass outline or brass text on velvet.

rules.name: The Faint Floor Rule
rules.body: The faintest text tier (sage-faint) must keep at least 4.5:1 on the velvet ground and wells; never introduce a dimmer text tone.

rules.name: The Explicit Body Rule
rules.body: Set the body font family and size on `body` itself, not only on `:root`: Chrome injects `body { font-family: system-ui; font-size: 75% }` on extension pages.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Marcellus is for names and headings (plus the title field); every control, label and number is Albert Sans.

rules.name: The Nap Everywhere Rule
rules.body: Any new velvet surface (ground, tray, well) layers `var(--nap)` over its tone; a flat green fill reads as plastic.

rules.name: The Down-Light Rule
rules.body: Shadows only fall downward; no glows, no colored halos except the 3px brass focus wash on fields and the verdigris halo on the published mark.

dos: **Do** layer the nap texture on every velvet surface and keep wells darker than the ground.
**Do** reserve brass metal for pressables; use brass outlines and brass text everywhere else.
**Do** show site state as a mark in its fixed cell, in fixed site order, with the words in a title or pill.
**Do** keep every photo at one scale and on the same well ground.
**Do** honor reduced motion: transitions and animations collapse to 1ms and the photo stops lifting, but color and border state changes stay visible.
donts: **Don't** add a light theme or any surface outside the velvet tones.
**Don't** fill informational elements (pills, tags, headings, badges) with solid brass.
**Don't** add glows, neon accents or glowing card edges.
**Don't** set UI controls or numbers in Marcellus, or let body text fall back to the extension's system-ui default.
